verdict.rationale: No evidence of any integration with real-time voice pipelines like LiveKit, Pipecat, or ElevenLabs, nor any documentation addressing latency requirements for live conversation. Cognee's documented integrations are limited to MCP-compatible coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline), data sources (Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Google Drive), and CLI/Docker/API access — none related to voice.
